channel.title: Unlock Pulse
channel.description: Token unlocks sized against circulating supply: monthly numbers, weekly calendars and deep dives.

item.title: Token unlocks in November 2026: data for journalists
item.description: 178 token unlocks in November 2026, 39 strong. Biggest vs circulating supply and by value, who receives them, how prices moved before past unlocks. Free to quote.

item.title: KAITO unlocks 17.6 million tokens every month. Is that 7% of supply, or 3.5%?
item.description: Kaito releases about 1.76% of its supply on the 19th–20th of each month, more than half of it to the team and investors. Size depends on which circulating figure you use. What 16 past payouts did to the price.

item.title: JCT and TA unlock in November, says the calendar. The project documents give other dates
item.description: Aggregator calendars put Janction (JCT) on November 10 and Trusta.AI (TA) on November 15. Read against the projects' own documents, the dates move to December 10 and November 21. What we checked and what to watch.

item.title: QAIT unlocks 462.5 million tokens on October 31. Is that 92% of supply, or 7%?
item.description: One unlock, four sizes: QAIT's October 31 cliff is 92%, 46%, 24% or 7.5% of circulating supply depending on whose figure you trust. What the data says and what to watch.
